legend: An unknown solar system is guarded from the attacks of aliens by n$$$n$$$ powerful starships. The starship number i$$$i$$$ is located in the coordinates (xi,yi,zi)$$$(x_i, y_i, z_i)$$$ and is powerful enough to protect the region of space within the radious ri$$$r_i$$$. Sadly, the capitans of the starships have been arguing a lot and the senat decided to reorganize the defensive system according to the following rules:
A subset of the n$$$n$$$ starships has to be chosen.
The chosen starships must have disjoint protected regions, so that capitans don't argue. (if two regions only just touch we treat them as disjoint)
The capitans of those starships will be payed more, but they will have to be responsible for radious 3 times bigger (those extended regions can intersect).
Finally, every point of space that was previously protected has to remain protected.
input: First line of input contains 1≤n≤100$$$1\leq n \leq 100$$$: the number of starships. The n follwing lines describes the starships, in each line there are four numbers: 1≤xi,yi,zi,ri≤104$$$1\leq x_i, y_i, z_i, r_i \leq 10^4$$$.
output: In the first line print how many starships you have chosen. In the second line print the numbers of the chosen starships. They can be in any order. If the answer does not not exist print "NO".

legend.ai: 一个未知的太阳系由 n$$$n$$$ 艘强大的星舰守卫，以抵御外星人的攻击。编号为 i$$$i$$$ 的星舰位于坐标 (xi,yi,zi)$$$(x_i, y_i, z_i)$$$，其能力足以保护半径为 ri$$$r_i$$$ 的空间区域。遗憾的是，星舰的舰长们经常争吵，参议院决定按照以下规则重组防御系统：
必须选出这 n$$$n$$$ 艘星舰的一个子集。
所选星舰的保护区域必须两两不相交，这样舰长们就不会争吵。（如果两个区域恰好相切，则将它们视为不相交。）
这些星舰的舰长将获得更高的报酬，但他们必须负责半径扩大为 3 倍的区域（这些扩展后的区域可以相交）。
最后，之前受到保护的空间中的每一个点都必须继续受到保护。

input.ai: 输入第一行包含 1≤n≤100$$$1\leq n \leq 100$$$：星舰的数量。接下来的 n 行描述这些星舰，每行有四个数字：1≤xi,yi,zi,ri≤104$$$1\leq x_i, y_i, z_i, r_i \leq 10^4$$$。

output.ai: 第一行输出你选择的星舰数量。第二行输出所选星舰的编号。它们可以按任意顺序排列。如果不存在答案，输出 "NO"。
